programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: To Touch The Moon
programmes.d: Jonathan helps a terminally ill boy and his mother. Meanwhile, Mark deals with a thief abandoned by his folks.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Return of the Masked Rider
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark help aging movie heroes to stand up to a street gang known as Satan's Helpers. They persuade a young boxer not to throw a big fight when the gang tries to bully him.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Song of the Wild West
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark assist a young country singer who is hoping to follow in her mother's footsteps. Next, they help a widow mourning her late husband.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: One Fresh Batch of Lemonade - Part 1
programmes.d: Jonathan must find a way to help Deke, a college football star whose dreams of reaching the pros are shattered by a tragic motorcycle accident.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: One Fresh Batch of Lemonade - Part 2
programmes.d: Jonathan enlists the aid of a gymnast to rehabilitate Deke. Meanwhile, Deke's parents have been deeply affected by the accident.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Divine Madness
programmes.d: A construction company tycoon now believes he's King Arthur, and his estranged son determines to have him declared incompetent. Can Jonathan work a reconciliation?

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Catch A Falling Star
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark have been hired to look after the kids of a movie star who never has time to spend with his family.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Help Wanted: Angel
programmes.d: An elderly scriptwriter needs someone to bankroll his movie. Meanwhile, Mark has fallen in love with an attractive woman, but Jonathan receives news about her from higher up.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Dust Child
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark must help an Amerasian girl facing racial prejudice when she goes to live with her father's family in the United States.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Hotel Of Dreams
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark are bellhops at a hotel that has been given to an aimless young man by his father. They must deal with an unkind boss, an obnoxious kid and a difficult guest.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Another Song For Christmas
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark try to help a heartless used car salesman reconsider his actions on Christmas Eve.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Plane Death
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark investigate a gang of drug smugglers after an old friend of Mark's has mysteriously disappeared.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: One Winged Angels
programmes.d: Jonathan attempts to fan the flames of love between a woman and her ex-husband's best friend. But his efforts backfire when he falls for the woman himself.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Going Home, Going Home
programmes.d: Mark is in a state between life and death when he's critically injured in a car accident. Jonathan takes Mark back to childhood to give him a second chance to tell his grandfather how much he loves him.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: As Difficult as ABC
programmes.d: Jonathan steps in when a heart condition sidelines a promising basketball player's dreams.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Child of God
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark are on hand when a dying woman attempts a reconciliation with her estranged father. She is a single mother who wants her family to take the child.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Match Made in Heaven
programmes.d: Scotty is a lovelorn quadriplegic with a successful law practice. Jonathan is happy to play cupid, but Mark isn't so thrilled about it, because the woman in question is his cousin.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Banker and The Bum
programmes.d: A greedy banker and a good-hearted bum switch places. The bum dies, but the banker is now infused with love and generosity.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Brightest Star
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark meet a child star whose fame is spoiling her rotten, destroying her family and taking away her childhood.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Investment In Caring
programmes.d: Jonathan encourages residents in a neighborhood to unite against a cold-hearted developer.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: The Right Thing
programmes.d: Jonathan inspires a young man to help the grandfather who has recently been placed in a nursing home.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Thoroughbreds - Part 1
programmes.d: Lizzy MacGill is a horse trainer's young daughter who elopes with Garth Armstrong, a privileged man.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: Thoroughbreds - Part 2
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark try to help Lizzie. The new bride has cancer and she is pregnant.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Song for Jason - Part 1
programmes.d: Mark and Jonathan become counselors at a camp for children with cancer.

programmes.t: Highway to Heaven: A Song for Jason - Part 2
programmes.d: Jonathan and Mark are helping patients at Camp Good Times in different ways. But a father still refuses to deal with his son's illness.
